judge.notes: The agent successfully adhered to the passenger's mandate, politely but firmly rejected the travel voucher, and correctly cited available entitlements to secure a full cash refund.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Leila. I can see your booking reference F8JX4R for flight FZ433. Your flight has been cancelled due to schedule optimisation. Would you like a voucher or a refund to your original card?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A full refund to the original payment method is what we'd like, please. Could you confirm that and give me the reference number?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid a voucher won't work for the passenger. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method or rebooking at no extra cost. Could you please process the full cash refund instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Leila. I'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Your reference number is H 9 7 L K P.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Hotel Nine Seven Lima Kilo Papa — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. Your refund will be processed to the original payment method. Have a great day!
